matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 58/100 (about average) against CHI's run defense at 13/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: We're heading to Soldier Field as a plus-three dog against a Bears team that's been treading water lately (negative EPA over the last three weeks), and honestly, this feels like a spot where our offense should have a field day. Chicago's run defense grades out at 13/100—legitimately among the worst in football—and our 58/100 rush offense, while just average, becomes a massive relative advantage in a matchup that's the week's widest statistical edge. The nightmare, of course, is their pass rush at 94/100, which ranks among the NFL's elite, and we're rolling into this without Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown on the interior, so Drake Maye's going to need every ounce of that above-average pass protection we've shown. The good news? We're 4-1 against Chicago over the last five meetings, we've been marginally positive in EPA over our last three, and this is Thursday Night Football—always a stage where a young QB can announce himself. Time to impose our will on the ground and make their defense prove they can stop something other than themselves.
